description: This Python source file sets up and configures the Jinja2 templating environment for the 'jwql' project. It defines a function to create and return a Jinja2 environment with added globals for Django static files and URLs, and includes a custom Jinja2 extension class 'DjangoNow' that implements a custom 'now' template tag for rendering the current date and time with optional timezone support.

classes.name: DjangoNow
classes.description: A custom Jinja2 extension implementing the 'now' template tag to render current date/time, optionally formatted and with timezone awareness.

methods.name: environment(**options)
methods.description: Creates and configures a Jinja2 Environment instance with global functions 'static' and 'url' for static asset URLs and Django URL reversing, respectively.

methods.name: _now(self, date_format)
methods.description: Method of DjangoNow extension that returns the current date/time formatted according to the provided format string, considering timezone if enabled.

methods.name: parse(self, parser)
methods.description: Method of DjangoNow extension that parses the 'now' tag in Jinja2 templates, optionally handling an 'as' variable for assignment.
